title: [Dtensor] torch.all() uses sum reduction incorrectly
bug_description:
When enabling bool tensor testing for torch.all() in test_math_ops.py, found that LINEAR_REDUCTION_OP_MAP is set to sum. The logic of all is AND logic and so should use the product operation.
